core_claims.name: addAssoc / addZeroRight / addSuccRight / addComm / addSwap / addRearrange
core_claims.scope: Universal addition associativity, right identity, successor movement, commutativity, three-term exchange and four-term regrouping on arbitrary naturals.

core_claims.name: mulZeroRight / mulSuccRight / mulComm / mulDistrib / mulDistribRight / mulAssoc / mulOneRight / mulSwap
core_claims.scope: Universal multiplication zero, successor, commutativity, both distributivity laws, associativity, unit, and exchange laws.

core_claims.name: powerAdd / powerMul / powerProduct
core_claims.scope: For all m,n,p: m^(n+p)=m^n*m^p; m^(n*p)=(m^n)^p; (m*n)^p=m^p*n^p, with the defined natural exponentiation.

core_claims.name: zeroMonus / monusAdd
core_claims.scope: For every n, zero monus n is zero; for every m,n,p, (m monus n) monus p = m monus (n+p).

core_claims.name: fromInc / fromTo
core_claims.scope: For every raw bitstring b, decoding inc b gives successor of decoding b; for every natural n, decoding its encoding gives n.

core_claims.name: notRawRoundTrip / normalizeValue / normalizeIdempotent
core_claims.scope: Refutes the unrestricted reverse round trip at Empty; proves value preservation and idempotence of normalization for all raw bitstrings.

deviations: Uses named operators and explicit equality composition/congruence, with rewrite where useful, rather than reproducing each Agda mixfix proof variant.
Finite unrollings of associativity are explained as specializations of the full inductive theorem rather than maintained as duplicate proof definitions.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
